name: photo-gallery
title: Photo Gallery
description: A honeycomb of diamond-cropped photos on a dark background. Pointing at one turns its diamond into a full rectangle, boosts its colour and greys out every other tile.
use: A portfolio, lookbook or photo wall where visitors should browse images one at a time without leaving the page.
avoid: Uses fixed pixel cells and :has(), so it needs recent browsers and a wide area and breaks on small screens.
a11y: Tiles are plain img elements with no tabindex, so the :focus style is unreachable from the keyboard; alt text is just image-0, image-1. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Ten photographs are cropped into sharp diamonds and packed into an offset honeycomb grid on a black stage, with small dark gaps between them. Colours are natural: red tulips, a green field, water, an orange sunset. On hover one diamond becomes a hard-edged rectangle while the rest turn grey.
behaves: Hovering or focusing a tile switches its clip from a diamond to a square, raising it above the others and boosting saturation. The rest of the gallery drops to half brightness and contrast, so only one photo stays lit. Moving away restores all diamonds.
customise: Pass an array of image sources plus containerClass, imageClass and a cell size in pixels; the diamond clip, dimming and hover timing are fixed in an injected style block.
weight: light: Ten images and pure CSS clip-path transitions; no script runs.
